aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the main YK dimension change context but has blocking grouping and comparison errors.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly includes TOTAL and MG-S-A/B/C as primary factors.
Function sub-results compare date subgroups to TOTAL Normal instead of matching subgroup Normal rows.
Function comparison rows omit needed Normal subgroup rows 4.5!54, 4.5!58, and 4.5!62.
Unverified measurement candidates from header-like rows should not be final evidence.
Tension.Gauss rows need grouping by matching spec and Normal/Test before judgement.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal vs Test YK change dimension for material YK supplier/dimension change.
Keep TOTAL, dates, line, and MG-S-A/B/C as subgroup or outcome context only.
Repair function outcome pairs as TOTAL 48/50 and date subgroup pairs 52/54, 56/58, 60/62.
Remove or quarantine extracted measurement stats based only on headers or mixed numeric rows.
Group Tension.Gauss by spec and condition, especially TEST vs Normal, before adding judged outcomes.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient until row grouping and matched-pair evidence are corrected.
